title: Figma token response placeholders and non-secret members
summary: Placeholder, template-reference, masked and empty values under access_token and refresh_token, a response with only non-secret members (client id, token type, lifetime, user id) and prose naming the members.
rationale: A placeholder, reference, masked or empty value stands in for a value that is kept elsewhere or has none, and the client id, token type, lifetime and user id are public or non-credential members that sit beside the two secrets in the same response. Prose that names the members carries no value.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: these inputs hold no credential value. That a placeholder, reference, masked or empty value is not a credential value is a project decision, not a Figma statement.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
